<thought>Using the given measurement (16.364 Ω between A and X1) and the note that the three resistors are in a 1 : 2 : 3 ratio, the simplest topology that satisfies this is a series chain of the three resistors. Let the base resistance be R, then R1 = R, R2 = 2R, R3 = 3R and total = 6R = 16.364 Ω → R ≈ 2.727 Ω. Thus R1 ≈ 2.727 Ω, R2 ≈ 5.455 Ω, R3 ≈ 8.182 Ω. Representing the series chain with two internal nodes (N1, N2) gives the required connections.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors":{"R1":2.727,"R2":5.455,"R3":8.182},"connections":[["A","N1","R1"],["N1","N2","R2"],["N2","X1","R3"]]}</final_answer>
